verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Render has a REST API docs section and publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at render.com/openapi.json. Neither shows an interactive API reference with runnable or 'try it' examples. A raw OpenAPI file is only a building block someone could use to build such a reference, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
